caption:
IIM Bangalore has said exactly what its interview checks. It is in their own FAQ 👇

Consistency in academic performance, clarity of motivation, communication skills, intellectual curiosity, extracurricular achievements, integrity and authenticity.

What that means for you:
1. Be ready to explain any dip in your marks, honestly
2. Know why this programme, and why you
3. Answer clearly, then stop
4. Show something you learned on your own
5. Talk about what you did, not what you joined
6. Say "I don't know" when you don't
7. Tell your own story, not a template

The interview is 40 of 100 in IIMB's final score. Practise all 7 with IIM alumni in our Interview Prep Batch, unlimited mock interviews for ₹99. Link in bio.
